scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:generate && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @ft/server" "npm run dev -w @ft/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @ft/server && npm run build -w @ft/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w @ft/server && npm run typecheck -w @ft/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
